data.name: trg_offset_links_bi
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_offset_links_bi BEFORE INSERT ON offset_links
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OFFSET_CURRENCY_MISMATCH')
    WHERE (SELECT currency FROM transactions WHERE id = new.expense_txn_id)
      IS NOT (SELECT currency FROM transactions WHERE id = new.source_txn_id)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions WHERE id = new.expense_txn_id)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions WHERE id = new.source_txn_id);
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OFFSET_PARTICIPANT_MISMATCH')
    WHERE new.participant_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM split_participants
      WHERE id = new.participant_id AND expense_txn_id = new.expense_txn_id);
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OFFSET_EXCEEDS_EXPENSE')
    WHERE new.amount_minor + (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_minor), 0) FROM offset_links
        WHERE expense_txn_id = new.expense_txn_id)
      > (SELECT amount_minor FROM transactions WHERE id = new.expense_txn_id);
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OFFSET_EXCEEDS_SOURCE')
    WHERE new.amount_minor + (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_minor), 0) FROM offset_links
        WHERE source_txn_id = new.source_txn_id)
      > (SELECT amount_minor FROM transactions WHERE id = new.source_txn_id);
END;

data.name: trg_offset_links_bu
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_offset_links_bu BEFORE UPDATE ON offset_links
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OFFSET_CURRENCY_MISMATCH')
    WHERE (SELECT currency FROM transactions WHERE id = new.expense_txn_id)
      IS NOT (SELECT currency FROM transactions WHERE id = new.source_txn_id)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions WHERE id = new.expense_txn_id)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions WHERE id = new.source_txn_id);
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OFFSET_PARTICIPANT_MISMATCH')
    WHERE new.participant_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM split_participants
      WHERE id = new.participant_id AND expense_txn_id = new.expense_txn_id);
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OFFSET_EXCEEDS_EXPENSE')
    WHERE new.amount_minor + (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_minor), 0) FROM offset_links
        WHERE expense_txn_id = new.expense_txn_id AND id <> old.id)
      > (SELECT amount_minor FROM transactions WHERE id = new.expense_txn_id);
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'OFFSET_EXCEEDS_SOURCE')
    WHERE new.amount_minor + (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_minor), 0) FROM offset_links
        WHERE source_txn_id = new.source_txn_id AND id <> old.id)
      > (SELECT amount_minor FROM transactions WHERE id = new.source_txn_id);
END;

data.name: transactions_fts_row
data.sql: CREATE VIEW transactions_fts_row AS SELECT id AS txn_id, CASE WHEN merchant_norm IS NULL OR merchant_norm = merchant_raw THEN merchant_raw WHEN merchant_raw IS NULL THEN merchant_norm ELSE merchant_raw || ' ' || merchant_norm END AS merchant, counterparty_value AS counterparty, note, latin || ' ' || "replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"(latin, '0', '٠'), '1', '١'), '2', '٢'), '3', '٣'), '4', '٤'), '5', '٥'), '6', '٦'), '7', '٧'), '8', '٨'), '9', '٩'), '.', '٫') AS amount_text FROM (SELECT id, merchant_raw, merchant_norm, counterparty_value, note, CASE WHEN currency IN ('BIF', 'CLP', 'DJF', 'GNF', 'ISK', 'JPY', 'KMF', 'KRW', 'PYG', 'RWF', 'UGX', 'UYI', 'VND', 'VUV', 'XAF', 'XOF', 'XPF') THEN format('%d', amount_minor) WHEN currency IN ('BHD', 'IQD', 'JOD', 'KWD', 'LYD', 'OMR', 'TND') THEN format('%d.%03d', amount_minor / 1000, amount_minor % 1000) WHEN currency IN ('CLF', 'UYW') THEN format('%d.%04d', amount_minor / 10000, amount_minor % 10000) ELSE format('%d.%02d', amount_minor / 100, amount_minor % 100) END AS latin FROM transactions)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_merchants" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id >= 1), "canonical" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(canonical) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), "name_ar" TEXT, "name_en" TEXT, "category_code" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(category_code) BETWEEN 2 AND 32 AND category_code GLOB '[a-z]*' AND category_code NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*'), "logo_key" TEXT, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_aliases" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "merchant_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_merchants(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "alias_norm" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(alias_norm) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND alias_norm NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9 ]*' AND alias_norm NOT GLOB ' *' AND alias_norm NOT GLOB '* ' AND alias_norm NOT GLOB '*  *'), "match" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("match" IN ('exact', 'prefix', 'token')), UNIQUE(alias_norm, merchant_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_alias_merchant ON catalog_aliases (merchant_id)
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_alias_fts" USING fts5(alias_norm, content='catalog_aliases', content_rowid='id', tokenize='trigram');
CREATE TRIGGER trg_alias_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON catalog_aliases BEGIN INSERT INTO catalog_alias_fts ("rowid", alias_norm) VALUES (new.id, new.alias_norm);END
CREATE TRIGGER trg_alias_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON catalog_aliases BEGIN INSERT INTO catalog_alias_fts (catalog_alias_fts, "rowid", alias_norm) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.alias_norm);END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_alias_fts_au AFTER UPDATE OF id, alias_norm ON catalog_aliases BEGIN INSERT INTO catalog_alias_fts (catalog_alias_fts, "rowid", alias_norm) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.alias_norm);INSERT INTO catalog_alias_fts ("rowid", alias_norm) VALUES (new.id, new.alias_norm);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_keywords" ("keyword_norm" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(keyword_norm) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND keyword_norm NOT GLOB('*[' || char(1) || '-' || char(31) || char(127) || '-' || char(159) || ']*')AND keyword_norm NOT GLOB ' *' AND keyword_norm NOT GLOB '* ' AND keyword_norm NOT GLOB '*  *'), "lang" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lang GLOB '[a-z][a-z]'), "category_code" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(category_code) BETWEEN 2 AND 32 AND category_code GLOB '[a-z]*' AND category_code NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*'), "weight" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(weight) = 'integer' AND weight BETWEEN 0 AND 100), PRIMARY KEY(keyword_norm, lang));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_meta" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "applied_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "signature_kid" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(signature_kid) BETWEEN 1 AND 128));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "system_code" TEXT UNIQUE, "parent_id" TEXT REFERENCES categories(id), "name_ar" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_en" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "bucket" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (bucket IN ('needs', 'wants', 'obligations', 'savings', 'income', 'giving')), "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_custom IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_archived IN (0, 1)), "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "merchant_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "match_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (match_kind IN ('catalog_merchant', 'merchant_norm', 'counterparty')), "match_value" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_applied_at" INTEGER, UNIQUE(match_kind, match_value), CHECK(match_kind <> 'merchant_norm' OR(length(match_value) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND match_value NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9 ]*' AND match_value NOT GLOB ' *' AND match_value NOT GLOB '* ' AND match_value NOT GLOB '*  *')), CHECK(match_kind <> 'catalog_merchant' OR(length(match_value) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND match_value GLOB '[1-9]*' AND match_value NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')), CHECK(match_kind <> 'counterparty' OR(length(match_value) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND match_value NOT GLOB('*[' || char(1) || '-' || char(31) || char(127) || '-' || char(159) || ']*'))));
CREATE INDEX ix_rules_category ON merchant_rules (category_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "category_id" TEXT REFERENCES categories(id), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (currency GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]'), "limit_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(limit_minor) = 'integer' AND limit_minor BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), "period" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (period IN ('cycle', 'annual')), "rollover" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (rollover IN (0, 1)), "thresholds" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[80,100]' CHECK (CASE WHEN json_valid(thresholds) THEN json_type(thresholds) = 'array' ELSE 0 END), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(category_id, currency, period));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_budgets_overall ON budgets (currency, period) WHERE category_id IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fired_alerts" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND kind NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*'), "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(subject_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), "period_key" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(period_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 64), "threshold" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (typeof(threshold) = 'integer' AND threshold >= 0), "fired_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(kind, subject_id, period_key, threshold));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cycle_summaries" ("cycle_start" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(cycle_start) IS cycle_start), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (currency GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]'), "account_filter" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '*' CHECK (length(account_filter) BETWEEN 1 AND 1024), "income_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(income_minor) = 'integer' AND income_minor BETWEEN -9007199254740991 AND 9007199254740991), "spend_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(spend_minor) = 'integer' AND spend_minor BETWEEN -9007199254740991 AND 9007199254740991), "by_category" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (CASE WHEN json_valid(by_category) THEN json_type(by_category) = 'object' ELSE 0 END), "computed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(cycle_start, currency, account_filter));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "institution_code" TEXT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('debit', 'credit', 'account', 'wallet', 'bnpl', 'cash', 'multi_currency')), "label" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(label) BETWEEN 1 AND 30), "last4" TEXT CHECK (last4 IS NULL OR(length(last4) BETWEEN 2 AND 4 AND last4 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')), "default_currency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (default_currency GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]'), "credit_limit_minor" INTEGER CHECK (credit_limit_minor IS NULL OR(typeof(credit_limit_minor) = 'integer' AND credit_limit_minor BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)), "statement_due_day" INTEGER CHECK (statement_due_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31), "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_hidden IN (0, 1)), "merged_into_id" TEXT REFERENCES accounts(id) CHECK (merged_into_id IS NULL OR merged_into_id <> id), "is_default_cash" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_default_cash IN (0, 1) AND(is_default_cash = 0 OR kind = 'cash')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('subscription', 'installment', 'card_due', 'gameya', 'bill')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('suggested', 'active', 'dismissed', 'completed')), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 60), "merchant_norm" TEXT CHECK (merchant_norm IS NULL OR(length(merchant_norm) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND merchant_norm NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9 ]*' AND merchant_norm NOT GLOB ' *' AND merchant_norm NOT GLOB '* ' AND merchant_norm NOT GLOB '*  *')), "account_id" TEXT REFERENCES accounts(id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), "currency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (currency GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]'), "cadence" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (cadence IN ('monthly', 'yearly', 'weekly', 'custom_days')), "cadence_days" INTEGER CHECK (cadence_days IS NULL OR cadence_days BETWEEN 1 AND 3660), "due_day" INTEGER CHECK (due_day IS NULL OR due_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31), "next_due_date" TEXT CHECK (next_due_date IS NULL OR date(next_due_date) IS next_due_date), "total_count" INTEGER CHECK (total_count IS NULL OR total_count >= 1), "paid_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (paid_count >= 0 AND(total_count IS NULL OR paid_count <= total_count)), "reminder_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3 CHECK (reminder_days BETWEEN 0 AND 60), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK((cadence = 'custom_days')=(cadence_days IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE INDEX ix_recurring_due ON recurring_items (next_due_date) WHERE status = 'active'
CREATE INDEX ix_recurring_account ON recurring_items (account_id) WHERE account_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "raw_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "channel" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('sms', 'notification', 'shortcut_message', 'apple_pay', 'share', 'paste', 'ocr', 'pdf', 'csv')), "sender" TEXT, "institution_code" TEXT, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "body_hash" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(body_hash) = 64 AND body_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), "received_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sim_slot" INTEGER, "parse_status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (parse_status IN ('parsed', 'review', 'dismissed', 'reparse_pending')), "template_id" TEXT, "template_version" INTEGER, "registry_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transfer_pairs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "out_txn_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES transactions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "in_txn_id" TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES transactions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('auto', 'manual', 'fx_conversion', 'card_settlement', 'cross_currency')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK(in_txn_id IS NULL OR in_txn_id <> out_txn_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id), "raw_message_id" TEXT REFERENCES raw_messages(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('sms', 'notification', 'shortcut', 'apple_pay', 'ocr', 'pdf', 'csv', 'voice', 'manual', 'share')), "direction" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('expense', 'income', 'transfer_out', 'transfer_in', 'refund', 'fee')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'posted' CHECK (status IN ('posted', 'pending', 'declined', 'reversed')), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL "merchant_norm" TEXT, "catalog_merchant_id" INTEGER, "counterparty_kind" TEXT CHECK (counterparty_kind IN ('merchant', 'ipa', 'phone', 'person', 'bank', 'own_account')), "counterparty_value" TEXT, CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_occurrences" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recurring_items(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (date(due_date) IS due_date), "txn_id" TEXT REFERENCES transactions(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "paid_at" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(item_id, due_date));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "split_participants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "expense_txn_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "share_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(share_minor) = 'integer' AND share_minor BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "offset_links" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('refund', 'reimbursement')), "expense_txn_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_txn_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_minor) = 'integer' AND amount_minor BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), "participant_id" TEXT REFERENCES split_participants(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(expense_txn_id, source_txn_id), CHECK(expense_txn_id <> source_txn_id));
CREATE INDEX ix_offset_participant ON offset_links (participant_id) WHERE participant_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TRIGGER trg_split_participant_move BEFORE UPDATE OF expense_txn_id ON split_participants WHEN new.expense_txn_id IS NOT old.expense_txn_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'OFFSET_PARTICIPANT_MISMATCH') WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM offset_links WHERE participant_id = old.id);END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_accounts_inst_last4 ON accounts (institution_code, last4) WHERE last4 IS NOT NULL AND merged_into_id IS NULL

CREATE TRIGGER trg_offset_links_bi BEFORE INSERT ON offset_links BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'OFFSET_CURRENCY_MISMATCH') WHERE (SELECT currency FROM transactions WHERE id = new.expense_txn_id) IS NOT (SELECT currency FROM transactions WHERE id = new.source_txn_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions WHERE id = new.expense_txn_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions WHERE id = new.source_txn_id);SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'OFFSET_PARTICIPANT_MISMATCH') WHERE new.participant_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM split_participants WHERE id = new.participant_id AND expense_txn_id = new.expense_txn_id);SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'OFFSET_EXCEEDS_EXPENSE') WHERE new.amount_minor + (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_minor), 0) FROM offset_links WHERE expense_txn_id = new.expense_txn_id) > (SELECT amount_minor FROM transactions WHERE id = new.expense_txn_id);SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'OFFSET_EXCEEDS_SOURCE') WHERE new.amount_minor + (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_minor), 0) FROM offset_links WHERE source_txn_id = new.source_txn_id) > (SELECT amount_minor FROM transactions WHERE id = new.source_txn_id);END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_offset_links_bu BEFORE UPDATE ON offset_links BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'OFFSET_CURRENCY_MISMATCH') WHERE (SELECT currency FROM transactions WHERE id = new.expense_txn_id) IS NOT (SELECT currency FROM transactions WHERE id = new.source_txn_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions WHERE id = new.expense_txn_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions WHERE id = new.source_txn_id);SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'OFFSET_PARTICIPANT_MISMATCH') WHERE new.participant_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM split_participants WHERE id = new.participant_id AND expense_txn_id = new.expense_txn_id);SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'OFFSET_EXCEEDS_EXPENSE') WHERE new.amount_minor + (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_minor), 0) FROM offset_links WHERE expense_txn_id = new.expense_txn_id AND id <> old.id) > (SELECT amount_minor FROM transactions WHERE id = new.expense_txn_id);SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'OFFSET_EXCEEDS_SOURCE') WHERE new.amount_minor + (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_minor), 0) FROM offset_links WHERE source_txn_id = new.source_txn_id AND id <> old.id) > (SELECT amount_minor FROM transactions WHERE id = new.source_txn_id);END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_txn_offset_bu BEFORE UPDATE OF amount_minor, currency ON transactions BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'OFFSET_CURRENCY_MISMATCH') WHERE new.currency IS NOT old.currency AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM offset_links WHERE expense_txn_id = old.id OR source_txn_id = old.id);SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'OFFSET_EXCEEDS_EXPENSE') WHERE (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_minor), 0) FROM offset_links WHERE expense_txn_id = old.id) > new.amount_minor;SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'OFFSET_EXCEEDS_SOURCE') WHERE (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_minor), 0) FROM offset_links WHERE source_txn_id = old.id) > new.amount_minor;END
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions_fts_src" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "txn_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "merchant" TEXT, "counterparty" TEXT, "note" TEXT, "amount_text" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions_fts" USING fts5(merchant, counterparty, note, amount_text, content='transactions_fts_src', content_rowid='id', tokenize='trigram remove_diacritics 1');

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions_fts_short" USING fts5(merchant, counterparty, content='transactions_fts_src', content_rowid='id', tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2', prefix='1 2');

CREATE VIEW transactions_fts_row AS SELECT id AS txn_id, CASE WHEN merchant_norm IS NULL OR merchant_norm = merchant_raw THEN merchant_raw WHEN merchant_raw IS NULL THEN merchant_norm ELSE merchant_raw || ' ' || merchant_norm END AS merchant, counterparty_value AS counterparty, note, latin || ' ' || "replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"("replace"(latin, '0', '٠'), '1', '١'), '2', '٢'), '3', '٣'), '4', '٤'), '5', '٥'), '6', '٦'), '7', '٧'), '8', '٨'), '9', '٩'), '.', '٫') AS amount_text FROM (SELECT id, merchant_raw, merchant_norm, counterparty_value, note, CASE WHEN currency IN ('BIF', 'CLP', 'DJF', 'GNF', 'ISK', 'JPY', 'KMF', 'KRW', 'PYG', 'RWF', 'UGX', 'UYI', 'VND', 'VUV', 'XAF', 'XOF', 'XPF') THEN format('%d', amount_minor) WHEN currency IN ('BHD', 'IQD', 'JOD', 'KWD', 'LYD', 'OMR', 'TND') THEN format('%d.%03d', amount_minor / 1000, amount_minor % 1000) WHEN currency IN ('CLF', 'UYW') THEN format('%d.%04d', amount_minor / 10000, amount_minor % 10000) ELSE format('%d.%02d', amount_minor / 100, amount_minor % 100) END AS latin FROM transactions)

CREATE TRIGGER trg_txn_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON transactions BEGIN INSERT INTO transactions_fts_src (txn_id, merchant, counterparty, note, amount_text) SELECT txn_id, merchant, counterparty, note, amount_text FROM transactions_fts_row WHERE txn_id = new.id;END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_txn_fts_au AFTER UPDATE OF id, merchant_raw, merchant_norm, counterparty_value, note, amount_minor, currency ON transactions BEGIN DELETE FROM transactions_fts_src WHERE txn_id = old.id;INSERT INTO transactions_fts_src (txn_id, merchant, counterparty, note, amount_text) SELECT txn_id, merchant, counterparty, note, amount_text FROM transactions_fts_row WHERE txn_id = new.id;END
CREATE TRIGGER trg_txn_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON transactions BEGIN DELETE FROM transactions_fts_src WHERE txn_id = old.id;END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_fts_src_ai AFTER INSERT ON transactions_fts_src BEGIN INSERT INTO transactions_fts ("rowid", merchant, counterparty, note, amount_text) VALUES (new.id, new.merchant, new.counterparty, new.note, new.amount_text);INSERT INTO transactions_fts_short ("rowid", merchant, counterparty) VALUES (new.id, new.merchant, new.counterparty);END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_fts_src_ad AFTER DELETE ON transactions_fts_src BEGIN INSERT INTO transactions_fts (transactions_fts, "rowid", merchant, counterparty, note, amount_text) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.merchant, old.counterparty, old.note, old.amount_text);INSERT INTO transactions_fts_short (transactions_fts_short, "rowid", merchant, counterparty) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.merchant, old.counterparty);END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_fts_src_au AFTER UPDATE ON transactions_fts_src BEGIN INSERT INTO transactions_fts (transactions_fts, "rowid", merchant, counterparty, note, amount_text) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.merchant, old.counterparty, old.note, old.amount_text);INSERT INTO transactions_fts_short (transactions_fts_short, "rowid", merchant, counterparty) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.merchant, old.counterparty);INSERT INTO transactions_fts ("rowid", merchant, counterparty, note, amount_text) VALUES (new.id, new.merchant, new.counterparty, new.note, new.amount_text);INSERT INTO transactions_fts_short ("rowid", merchant, counterparty) VALUES (new.id, new.merchant, new.counterparty);END
